claim: Patchline ships an independently-audited multi-org incident reduction with pooled, pre-registered analysis. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the multi-org incident reduction claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make multi-org-incident-reduction-2-gate`.
